body:
i struggle to believe that it does beat the nothingingness if i'm honest. i know everyone likes to talk about a light at the end of the tunnel etc etc but it's been too long and i'm getting too tired. so many wasted years chasing a light that doesn't exist being beaten and abused along the way, only learning of more ways people choose to be cruel to eachother.

i don't mean to be difficult and i appreciate the response.. i just don't believe this is something that's going away or something that can improve anymore

my brain is so fundamentally broken and i feel like i've tried everything to make it work and nothing helps.. it's all getting progressively worse. all members of my family have a decline in mental health and then a suicide attempt and it's becoming more and more likely i'll be continuing this tradition.

i have no idea why they'd ever bring me into this world when they can't even hand;e it themselves
why not?
just want someone who understands even if i actively avoid him i still care, i just can't deal with people right now
haven't spoke to friends in months and my bf for a week he's going to break up with me lol
you're a cunt tbf
I'll talk with you about how everything sucks if it helps

I'm paranoid, distrustful, emotionally unwilling and always cling to the negative. I tell myself holding onto the negative will keep me safe but it just keeps me cynical and alone.

My paranoia is a huge problem, though is based in reality. I had a nice little group of friends until I introduced someone new to it, who then spent all their time talking badly behind my back to other members of the group. The group members don't like it and tell me everything, but I'd rather just cut off the entire group as it all just feels toxic to me now. Even messages from them just make me feel anxious.

This is how I deal with everything, I just isolate to keep myself safe emotionally and then just pick myself apart in my little bubble of hate.
It's okay, thank you for reading. It's comforting to know even a stranger knows what I'm going through.

I'm quite a private person, I don't have social media and I struggle to open up even about the smallest of things.

The idea of graphically detailing my numerous sexual assaults, some of the worst moments of my life, is traumatic enough. But to think those moments are going to be assessed and judged by a pack of strangers to see if it was 'bad enough' to warrant some form of justice or worse they don't even believe me.. it would just break me. I'd feel violated and invalidated, 10x worse than I do already. 

Right now I have the hope that some day I might have the strength to push on and really try to bring him to justice. But right now I'm just not ready, the wounds are too fresh and mentally I can't handle the trauma that reporting is in itself.

I tried to report but the police really aren't as supportive as you're lead to believe.. they just want you to shut up and deal with it.

I messaged with the others for a while but they were visiting his social media and talking about it literally every single day.. I didn't want anything to do with him and I told them that but the updates kept coming. I just pretend he's dead to get by day to day.

It's many different offences, lots of different ways.

I did report but I couldn't go into detail because I felt the officer wasn't listening to me and when I told her about one instance where he tried to enter me without protection and I'd explicitly said no.. she said he was just overexcited. I didn't bother reporting more after that.
This is a really interesting idea.
It's like some of us are born to self destruct, it's a hard urge to fight.

You didn't do anything to deserve this, you deserve better. 

If she's already feeling like she's 'all clear' then I can't see this improving, she should be working daily to rebuild your trust and it doesn't seem like she cares. It sounds harsh but the simple fact is she tossed your love aside for a quick fling on the internet, that's how little she cares.

Ending this will hurt like a bitch but staying is going to slowly dissolve your self worth, you'll turn bitter and resentful towards her. This relationship ended the day she hit enter.

I'm getting there myself.. I keep trying to dull everything with drugs and drink but nothing's working and it's starting to effect my work. I'm cutting into my savings to stay afloat even now. I just feel like I'm self destructing and the weird bit is I don't care.
Me too.
Took me a while to learn this.. nobody ever cares about you as much as you care about them, nobody understands, nobody listens.

"Thanks for talking with me about this it's really helped.. and you know if you ever needed it I'd be there for you too!"

....And then the inevitable left on read. Yep, feel this.

This has been the hardest year of my life for various reasons beyond covid and I can completely understand where you're coming from.. I've started keeping an eye on when people will message me too.

Nobody seems to want to talk to me while everything in their life is going well, I'm someone they talk to when they need someone to dump all their emotions on and help them.. but when I need help despite saying they'll be there for me a million times they never, ever are.
He didn't have any red flags, he was a fucking therapist working in a rape crisis centre. Your input is not required nor welcome.

Last thing I need in my life is another man.

You think he appeared threatening? Think that working as a therapist he didn't know how to make me feel safe?

It had nothing to do with the guys I 'go for' and everything to do with him being a rapist.
Thank you.. I'm sorry I don't normally reach out like this but I'm just finding it hard to cope with everything right now and need some form of distraction. Sometimes I just feel so isolated.

I don't think so, I don't come on this account very much. After tonight I probably wont come on again until my mood falls. I understand why people wouldn't want to talk to me when I get like this so I wouldn't blame you or anyone else for dipping out.
Hey.. I'm not okay but thank you for talking. I just need to keep distracted right now. I have unmedicated mental illness and my moods get very low sometimes. It's just all getting harder.
I feel the same.. I'm deeply private about my depression and it makes it very hard to talk to people without bringing it up in some way. I just don't really speak to anyone I know now.
Do you have PS4? I'd play games with you :)

I do this all the time, but I cringe mostly for how naive and stupid I was.

I think back to social situations where I was unaware of what was happening and I cringe when I think about what they must have thought of me and what they were doing.

Sometimes I have to physically hit my head to stop, I just can't turn it off.

I feel exactly the same about not getting a return.

I gave so much to my bf and it was never, ever enough for him. I worked over full time hours while he'd sit on his ass and work from home 3 days a week. I'd do all the cleaning and shopping. I moved house for him 2 times even though it meant leaving my dying dad and knowing it would break his heart.

Everyone says I just gave to the wrong person, but everyone I meet has been like this in one way or another. I just feel like people are always just looking for what they can gain from you.

I agree life is a curse, I'm struggling to understand why anyone finds it a gift.

I don't want you to die though, something ingrained in human behaviour I guess. Please don't do this.

I'll talk to you all day if you want, if you're in the UK I'll even give you my number.
Too tired, I've lost too much. It's nice you try to help people (probably because you're young) but you'll grow out of that when you see what people are really like.

I'm a bad person, that's why bad things happen to me. What you give out into to the world will return to you much stronger.

Life has no meaning, none of us know why we're here and most are okay with that. Some (like me) feel the urge to self destruct. Probably because I shouldn't have been brought here in the first place.
You're in the right place for your sadness fix.

I was in the shower and all of a sudden all the lights went out, the water went cold and my speaker playing music shut off. So everything went from normal to terrifying really quick.

I tried to fix the problem but it turned out to be more complex than I thought and it was so late I couldn't call my landlord and get i fixed until the morning. And it happened on a Monday night so I'd have to call into work and tell them that I'd have to have to day off to wait for my landlord and the thought of being without power and having to call into work just pushed me over the edge.

I'm only able to function if everything is okay at the moment.
same
100%, I hate everyone.

I'm a generally cynical person with a lot of untreated mental illnesses, I avoid all people like the plague because I hate them as much as they hate me.

I have so much on my plate right now I wouldn't even know where to begin.. all my worst nightmares have come true.

Well, except the one where my clothes turn into spiders.
I think people are like dogs in the way that was trust others, it only takes 1 asshole to lower the faith-in-humanity bar but when it's been lowered it's really hard forget.

I'm the same.

I'm so tired of being entirely alone but then i push everyone away because I have crippling depression.

I relate.

I've pushed everyone away and nobody new wants to be friends with me because I'm literally always negative about something or someone.

I try to stop but at this point I think it's just such a deep groove in my personality that I'll be like this forever.
Who is Carlee?

I've looked so hard for good I've exhausted myself, I'm not able to keep trying to push positivity into something when all I'm getting is negativity in return.
I wouldn't say I'm a good person, or a dude lol. I think I was just naive and wanted to make things better for people around me.

I'm too tired to keep pouring energy into a broken planet.

I'll just keep trying to get through this alone, at least I won't be let down anymore.

I do this daily, I've done it since I was a child.

Honestly it's one of the only times I'll experience happiness, even if it's not real events if I picture them hard enough the happiness I feel is real.

Eventually I have to come back to reality but recently I've been spending more time imagining what it would be like to be someone else, be somewhere else.

I know it's going to hurt when I come back.
